top.line: A page that builds a first version of a website in your browser, showing every agent, policy and penny.

in-short.line: Web Summit's browser demos, now for websites: describe, add your key, build, watch, get a zip, compare models.

demos.line: The X-ray researched a company and mapped a behaviour policy; a voice note became a deck and an infographic.

idea.line: A first pass of a website, built in front of you, all in the browser.

ux.line: One page: describe it or say it, your own key, designs, pictures, budget and models, checks, build.

watch.line: Each agent's card shows its work, cost and policy; the guard refuses on screen; two layers of policy.

evals.line: The cost against a budget, and the same brief on £1, £3, £5 and Opus runs, side by side, in an eval vault.

sovereign.line: Static page, key in the tab, a zip in local storage, a recorded run, open code.

why.line: It shows everything we describe in minutes, and what the paid version adds.

name.line: Working title: watch it build; others: the build room, build in the open, a live build.

limits.line: Not built; mock-up costs invented; sgit in the browser and the guard to confirm.

sources.line: The Web Summit demos and the Sovereign Website pieces of 19 November.
